solution_sketch: Use the reversal identity a% of b = b% of a. Swap the operands: 84% of 25 = 25% of 84 = 84 / 4 = 21. The direct route 25 × 84 / 100 = 2100 / 100 = 21 also works but wastes seconds on a two-digit product; the swap turns it into a quarter.
difficulty_rationale: Naive route is 25 × 84 / 100, which is doable but eats most of the 20 seconds on a two-digit multiplication. The insight — a% of b = b% of a — is a single line of algebra and reduces the problem to 84 / 4, findable cold. Answer is a small integer, so no arithmetic residue survives the trick. Too involved for a two-second glance because the direct computation is not trivial; too fast to lose because the swap is one step.
